going_concern.quote: It is management’s opinion that these conditions raise substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.floating_convertible: In the event of default, the Conversion Price shall be equal to 65% of the lowest trading price of the common stock as reported on the OTC Markets on which the Company’s shares are then traded or any exchange upon which the common stock may be traded in the future, for the ten prior trading days including the day upon which a Notice of Conversion is received by the Company.
financing_terms.equity_line: Common Stock: Shares issued for Common Stock Purchase Agreement On November 30, 2021, the Company entered into a Common Stock Purchase Agreement (the “Purchase Agreement”) with Dutchess Capital Growth Fund LP, a Delaware limited partnership, (“Dutchess”), providing for an equity financing facility (the “Equity Line”).
